name: Banh kho me
summary: Bánh khô mè is a sesame cake of glutinous rice flour, sesame, and sugar. In Da Nang the Cẩm Lệ cake is the gift and the offering at anniversaries and Tết.
origin: Quảng Nam and Da Nang. Bánh khô mè Bà Liễu mẹ is a traditional gift cake of the city.
culture: People in Da Nang buy it to offer first and share after, at giỗ and at Tết. The workshop is K200/1 Ông Ích Đường, Cẩm Lệ, and it is also at the airport and in souvenir shops.
howToEat: Take it home as a gift, or buy it for an offering.
where: K200/1 Ông Ích Đường, Cẩm Lệ, plus the airport and the specialty shops named with that workshop.
seoTitle: Banh kho me — sesame cake from Cam Le
seoDescription: Bánh khô mè is a sesame cake of glutinous rice flour, sesame, and sugar. The Cẩm Lệ cake, at K200/1 Ông Ích Đường, is a gift and an offering.
